verdict.rationale: No evidence pack content addresses data retention policies, deletion controls, or privacy settings for stored session data, recordings, or profiles; community evidence even suggests scraping is done without regard to opt-out mechanisms like robots.txt, but this doesn't speak to retention/deletion controls directly. This is a fair axis for a cloud browser automation service handling user data (recordings, profiles, scraped data), so absence of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'na'.
